title: Arthropod Mobs
blurb: Mobs in the #minecraft:arthropod entity type tag. Arthropods take extra damage from Bane of Arthropods, which also applies Slowness IV.
note: Tier A. 5 entity types carry #minecraft:arthropod in 26.2. Icon borrowed from the Spider, the arthropod a player meets first and the mob the Bane of Arthropods enchantment is named around.
